Mobile App Development.subtitle: Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering (Flutter, React Native, Android & iOS)

weeks.title: Mobile Toolchain, SDK Setup & Environment Architecture
weeks.summary: Establish Flutter/React Native dev environments, Android Studio SDKs, emulators, and Git workflow.
objectives: Configure Android Studio, Flutter/React Native CLI, and physical device USB debugging.
Initialize multi-environment config (.env, build variants, launch configurations).
Establish conventional Git branching strategy (feature/onboarding, releases).

tasks.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Environment & Starter Scaffold
tasks.description: Install Flutter/React Native SDKs, verify `flutter doctor` or `npx react-native doctor`, scaffold project, and run on Android emulator or physical device.
steps: 1. Install Flutter 3.x+ or Node.js 20+ with React Native CLI.
2. Configure Android SDK Platform Tools (API 34+) and test virtual emulator.
3. Create new project with clean folder structure (lib/presentation, lib/domain, lib/data).
4. Commit clean scaffold to GitHub with detailed README setup instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero errors on platform doctor diagnosis.
App compiles and renders successfully on physical device or emulator.
GitHub repository contains valid .gitignore (no build/ or .gradle files).
tasks.hint: Submit your public GitHub repository URL and emulator screenshot.

tasks.title: Theme Design System & Responsive Base Scaffold
tasks.description: Construct light/dark theme tokens, typography scale (Plus Jakarta Sans), app bar, and bottom navigation shell.
steps: 1. Implement design token palette matching Uzair AI Studio Iris theme.
2. Build adaptive bottom navigation bar with active screen tabs.
3. Ensure dynamic scaling across small and large phone displays.
acceptanceCriteria: Smooth theme switching between light and dark modes.
Zero UI overflow errors (RenderFlex overflow = 0).
tasks.codeTemplate:
ThemeData.light().copyWith(
  colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Color(0xFF4F46E5)),
  useMaterial3: true,
)
tasks.hint: Test on both narrow screen (360dp) and tablet viewports.

weeks.title: Modern UI Component Engineering & State Architecture
weeks.summary: Master component hierarchy, modular UI cards, forms, and state management (Bloc/Riverpod/Zustand).
objectives: Implement reactive state management pattern (Bloc/Provider/Riverpod).
Build reusable custom widgets: buttons, cards, status badges, modal bottom sheets.
Integrate reactive form validation with real-time feedback.

tasks.title: State Management Implementation (Bloc / Riverpod)
tasks.description: Scaffold a state-managed feature module (e.g. User Profile or Product Catalog) handling Initial, Loading, Success, and Error states.
steps: 1. Define Event, State, and Bloc/Notifier classes.
2. Connect UI view to state stream using BlocBuilder or useAtom.
3. Add simulated network delay and verify loading spinners and error fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Clean separation of UI presentation from business logic.
Proper error handling when simulating unexpected state failures.
tasks.hint: Provide a recording or GIF showing Loading -> Success state transitions.

tasks.title: Interactive Client Consultation & Booking Form
tasks.description: Build an interactive multi-step mobile form with input masks (WhatsApp phone, email, project budget picker, timeline slider).
steps: 1. Implement step-by-step form with validation at each transition.
2. Add input formatters for international phone numbers.
3. Display animated summary bottom sheet prior to submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid inputs show clear error messages below fields.
Form state persists during device orientation changes.
tasks.codeTemplate:
TextFormField(
  keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
  validator: (val) => val == null || val.length < 10 ? 'Enter valid WhatsApp' : null,
)
tasks.hint: Include haptic feedback on successful form submit.

weeks.title: REST APIs, Asynchronous Networking & Caching
weeks.summary: Connect mobile client to backend REST endpoints, manage token interceptors, and implement offline caching.
objectives: Implement robust HTTP client with Dio / Axios with request/response interceptors.
Parse JSON into type-safe immutable data models.
Build offline-first caching layer using Hive, Isar, or SQLite (WatermelonDB).

tasks.title: Type-Safe HTTP Client & Token Interceptors
tasks.description: Create a networking service connecting to Uzair AI Studio API (`/api/internship/verify/:id` and `/api/notifications`). Include auth bearer token injection.
steps: 1. Configure base Dio client with 15s timeout and automatic retry logic.
2. Create Interceptor injecting `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on secured routes.
3. Parse API response into freezed/equatable data model.
acceptanceCriteria: Network errors (401, 404, 500) caught and mapped to user-friendly UI banners.
Passes unit tests for model JSON deserialization.
tasks.codeTemplate:
final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: 'https://uzairaistudio.com/api', connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 15)));
dio.interceptors.add(AuthInterceptor());
tasks.hint: Verify behavior when airplane mode is toggled.

tasks.title: Offline-First Local Database Synchronization
tasks.description: Integrate local storage (Hive/SQLite) to cache candidate credentials, curriculum milestones, and notes for offline viewing.
steps: 1. Initialize local database box/table during app startup.
2. On successful network fetch, write records to local storage.
3. When offline, immediately serve cached records with an 'Offline Mode' indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: App launches and loads candidate data seamlessly with zero internet connection.
Data synchronizes automatically when connection is restored.
tasks.codeTemplate:
final box = await Hive.openBox('intern_data');
await box.put('current_user', userModel.toJson());
tasks.hint: Display an amber status pill when serving cached local data.

weeks.title: Device Hardware, Camera, QR Scanner & Biometrics
weeks.summary: Access native platform APIs: optical camera scanner, local push notifications, and biometric authentication.
objectives: Implement live QR code scanner to verify physical Uzair AI Studio ID badges.
Integrate biometric authentication (Fingerprint / Face ID).
Trigger local sound notifications and status updates.

tasks.title: High-Speed Optical QR Scanner Integration
tasks.description: Integrate `mobile_scanner` or `react-native-camera` to scan applicant ID QR codes and route immediately to verified candidate sheet.
steps: 1. Request runtime camera permissions gracefully.
2. Render viewfinder overlay with animated scanning line.
3. Parse scanned QR payload (e.g. `UAIS-INT-XXXXX`), trigger haptic buzz, and load profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Accurately decodes QR within 500ms under standard indoor lighting.
Handles camera permission denial with instructional dialog.
tasks.hint: Test with the sample QR code printed on the official ID badge.

tasks.title: Local Audio Notification & Push Alerts Engine
tasks.description: Implement local push notifications with custom sound chimes when a new task or announcement is published.
steps: 1. Initialize notification channels with HIGH importance and sound enabled.
2. Bundle synthesized audio chime asset into app bundle.
3. Schedule local notification when a background sync succeeds.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification banner appears in system tray with studio logo icon.
Notification sound plays clearly on physical hardware.
tasks.hint: Check battery optimization whitelist on Android.

weeks.title: Complex Animations, Micro-Interactions & Gestures
weeks.summary: Design delightful fluid micro-interactions, hero page transitions, shimmer loading skeletons, and gesture controls.
objectives: Master explicit animations using AnimationController and CurvedAnimation.
Build custom shimmer skeleton loaders for zero-layout-shift UI.
Implement swipe-to-dismiss and pull-to-refresh interactions.

tasks.title: Shimmer Loading Skeleton & Smooth Transitions
tasks.description: Replace generic circular spinners with high-end shimmer skeleton loading placeholders matching candidate cards and project cards.
steps: 1. Create SkeletonCard mirroring the dimensions of real content cards.
2. Add linear gradient shimmer sweeping continuously across placeholders.
3. Cross-fade smoothly into real content when API data arrives.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero layout jump/shift when content transitions from loading to loaded.
Animation runs at steady 60fps / 120fps with no frame jank.
tasks.codeTemplate:
Shimmer.fromColors(
  baseColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
  highlightColor: Colors.grey.shade100,
  child: Container(height: 120, decoration: BoxDecoration(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16))),
)
tasks.hint: Measure frame rate using Flutter DevTools Performance overlay.

tasks.title: Hero Transition & Expandable Document Vault Cards
tasks.description: Implement Hero tag animation connecting the dashboard document vault thumbnail to a full-screen interactive credential preview.
steps: 1. Wrap document badge with unique Hero tag.
2. On tap, expand smoothly to full-screen viewer with pinch-to-zoom capability.
3. Include floating action button to direct print or share credential.
acceptanceCriteria: Clean 300ms bezier curve transition with no clipping glitches.
Allows double-tap to zoom on high-res certificates.
tasks.codeTemplate:
Hero(
  tag: 'cert_${intern.id}',
  child: CertificateCard(intern: intern),
)
tasks.hint: Enable physics-based bounce on release.

weeks.title: Background Tasks, Deep Linking & PWA Portability
weeks.summary: Configure background fetch workers, universal deep links (`https://uzairaistudio.com/verify?id=...`), and Web/PWA builds.
objectives: Configure Android App Links & iOS Universal Links.
Implement background sync service worker.
Compile multi-platform build for Web/PWA and Android APK.

tasks.title: Universal Deep Linking & QR Route Handler
tasks.description: Configure deep link intent filters so scanning an Uzair AI Studio link automatically opens the mobile app to the exact candidate profile.
steps: 1. Add `<intent-filter>` for scheme `https` and host `uzairaistudio.com` in AndroidManifest.
2. Parse initial URI and dynamic stream in app router.
3. Verify deep link via adb command: `adb shell am start -d 'https://uzairaistudio.com/verify?id=UAIS-INT-SAMPLE'`
acceptanceCriteria: App automatically opens and navigates directly to the target verification screen.
Gracefully falls back to home screen if ID is invalid.
tasks.codeTemplate:
<intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">
  <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
  <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
  <data android:scheme="https" android:host="uzairaistudio.com" android:pathPrefix="/verify" />
</intent-filter>
tasks.hint: Check Android 12+ domain verification requirements.

tasks.title: PWA Offline Compilation & Service Worker Deployment
tasks.description: Compile the Flutter/React Native application to modern Web PWA, installable on mobile Chrome/Safari with offline caching.
steps: 1. Configure manifest.json with 192x192 & 512x512 icons and standalone display mode.
2. Register service worker caching core JS/Wasm bundles and assets.
3. Deploy to live staging hosting (Vercel, Firebase, or Netlify).
acceptanceCriteria: Lighthouse PWA score >= 90.
Mobile browser shows 'Install Uzair AI Studio' app prompt.
tasks.codeTemplate:
{
  "name": "Uzair AI Studio Mobile",
  "short_name": "UzairStudio",
  "start_url": "/intern-portal",
  "display": "standalone",
  "theme_color": "#4F46E5"
}
tasks.hint: Test 'Add to Home Screen' on real mobile device.

weeks.title: Production Hardening, Security, Obfuscation & Testing
weeks.summary: Secure API keys, enable ProGuard/R8 code shrinking, write comprehensive integration tests, and optimize APK footprint.
objectives: Write comprehensive widget and integration tests (>= 80% coverage on core logic).
Secure secrets using flutter_secure_storage and keystore encryption.
Optimize app bundle size (reduce APK under 25MB with split per ABI).

tasks.title: Integration Testing Suite & Automation
tasks.description: Write end-to-end integration tests automating: Login -> View Curriculum -> Complete Task -> Open Document Vault.
steps: 1. Write integration test script finding widgets by key and simulating taps.
2. Mock backend responses to test both online and offline paths.
3. Run test runner: `flutter test integration_test/app_test.dart` and export report.
acceptanceCriteria: All test assertions pass cleanly with zero uncaught exceptions.
Core candidate journey automated without manual intervention.
tasks.hint: Use unique ValueKeys on all primary interactive buttons.

tasks.title: ProGuard/R8 Obfuscation & Split-ABI Release Build
tasks.description: Configure ProGuard rules, enable resource shrinking, and build optimized Release APKs split by architecture (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a).
steps: 1. Enable `minifyEnabled true` and `shrinkResources true` in android/app/build.gradle.
2. Add keep rules for reflective models in proguard-rules.pro.
3. Execute release build: `flutter build apk --split-per-abi --obfuscate --split-debug-info=./symbols`
acceptanceCriteria: Release arm64-v8a APK size reduced significantly (under 20MB).
App launches without crashing from over-aggressive shrinking.
tasks.hint: Verify signed APK with jarsigner / apksigner.

weeks.title: Production Deployment, CI/CD Pipeline & Final Capstone
weeks.summary: Ship completed production build, establish GitHub Actions automated build pipeline, and deliver capstone portfolio.
objectives: Set up automated GitHub Actions workflow building signed APKs on every main commit.
Complete end-to-end Capstone Mobile App with live backend integration.
Generate production release notes and submit final evaluation.

tasks.title: Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD Build Workflow
tasks.description: Create `.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml` that checks out code, runs tests, compiles signed release APKs, and uploads build artifacts.
tasks.deliverableType: GitHub Workflow YAML & Green Pipeline Run
steps: 1. Configure action with Java 17 and Flutter/Node setup actions.
2. Inject base64-encoded release keystore via GitHub Secrets.
3. Compile release APK and upload artifact using `actions/upload-artifact@v4`.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated CI passes all linting, analysis, and build steps.
Green checkmark on GitHub commit status.
tasks.codeTemplate:
name: Mobile CI/CD
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      - run: flutter pub get
      - run: flutter test
      - run: flutter build apk --split-per-abi
tasks.hint: Store keystore passwords securely in repository secrets.

tasks.title: Final Capstone Presentation & Production Release
tasks.description: Polish your full Capstone Mobile Application. Include complete documentation, architecture diagram, video demo walkthrough, and release APK.
tasks.deliverableType: GitHub Final Release, Demo Video & APK
steps: 1. Publish official GitHub Release (v1.0.0) with signed APK assets attached.
2. Record a 3-5 minute professional Loom video demonstrating all features.
3. Write executive README with architecture diagrams, setup instructions, and feature highlights.
acceptanceCriteria: Capstone represents industry-grade production engineering.
All weekly milestones verified and approved by Mentor Muhammad Uzair.
tasks.codeTemplate:
# Uzair AI Studio Mobile Platform v1.0.0
Official production mobile engineering release by candidate.
- Download APK: [releases/v1.0.0/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk]
- Video Walkthrough: [Demo Link]
tasks.hint: Congratulations! Upon mentor review, your Certificate, LOR, and Experience Letter will unlock in the Document Vault.

Generative AI.subtitle: Large Language Models, Multi-Agent Systems, RAG Architectures & Vector Databases

weeks.title: Modern AI Toolchain, API Setup & Prompt Engineering Foundations
weeks.summary: Configure Python 3.11+, OpenAI/Gemini/Groq SDKs, Jupyter environments, and master structured prompting.
objectives: Set up virtual environments (venv/conda), python-dotenv, and API keys securely.
Master structured few-shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and ReAct prompting patterns.
Implement deterministic JSON schema outputs using Pydantic and function calling.

tasks.title: Secure AI Developer Environment & SDK Client
tasks.description: Scaffold a Python AI workspace, configure `.env` secrets, establish unified client wrapper for OpenAI / Google Gemini API, and handle rate limits.
steps: 1. Initialize virtual environment and install requirements (openai, google-generativeai, pydantic, tenacity).
2. Create a unified `LLMClient` class with automatic exponential backoff retry logic.
3. Verify client connectivity with simple prompt execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero API keys leaked to version control (.gitignore verified).
Handles API rate-limiting gracefully with exponential backoff.
tasks.codeTemplate:
from pydantic import BaseModel
class ProjectBrief(BaseModel):
    title: str
    tech_stack: list[str]
    budget_estimate_usd: int
tasks.hint: Include token consumption metrics in logs.

tasks.title: Structured CoT Prompt Pipeline with Pydantic Validation
tasks.description: Design a structured prompt pipeline that analyzes client engineering requests, breaks them into architectural components, and returns validated Pydantic JSON.
steps: 1. Define Pydantic schema for ClientProjectArchitecture.
2. Use tool calling / response_format json_object to enforce strict output.
3. Validate output against edge cases (incomplete briefs, conflicting requirements).
acceptanceCriteria: 100% schema validation compliance over 10 diverse test prompts.
Contains step-by-step reasoning tokens before final JSON block.
tasks.codeTemplate:
completion = client.beta.chat.completions.parse(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "system", "content": "You are Lead Architect at Uzair AI Studio."}],
    response_format=ProjectBrief,
)
tasks.hint: Test with real client briefs from the studio intake form.

weeks.title: Vector Databases, Text Embeddings & Semantic Search
weeks.summary: Understand embedding spaces, cosine similarity, chunking strategies, and vector index persistence.
objectives: Generate dense embeddings using text-embedding-3-small or sentence-transformers.
Scaffold ChromaDB / Pinecone / Qdrant vector index.
Benchmark chunking strategies (RecursiveCharacter vs Semantic Chunking).

tasks.title: Document Preprocessing & Multi-Strategy Chunking Pipeline
tasks.description: Build an ingestion pipeline that reads technical documentation (PDF/Markdown/Code), applies recursive chunking with metadata tags, and benchmarks token overlaps.
steps: 1. Load real software documentation documents.
2. Implement RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter with chunk_size=500 and overlap=50.
3. Attach document metadata (source, section, timestamp, page_number) to every chunk.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero lost text across chunk boundaries.
Metadata properly serialized for downstream vector retrieval.
tasks.codeTemplate:
from langchain_text_splitters import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
    chunk_size=600, chunk_overlap=80, separators=['\n## ', '\n### ', '\n', ' ']
)
tasks.hint: Compare search results when varying chunk sizes from 250 to 1000 tokens.

tasks.title: Local ChromaDB Vector Store & Semantic Query Engine
tasks.description: Index software engineering knowledge chunks into ChromaDB with cosine similarity, and build a semantic search CLI displaying relevance scores.
steps: 1. Initialize persistent ChromaDB collection on local disk.
2. Embed and upsert 100+ technical knowledge chunks with IDs.
3. Query collection with natural language and return top-k results with distance metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic queries return top 3 relevant chunks within 100ms.
Demonstrates semantic similarity (e.g. searching 'mobile cross-platform' retrieves 'Flutter').
tasks.codeTemplate:
import chromadb
chroma_client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path="./chroma_db")
collection = chroma_client.get_or_create_collection(name="studio_knowledge")
tasks.hint: Normalize cosine distance to percentage similarity.

weeks.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Architecture
weeks.summary: Design full end-to-end RAG systems combining query rewriting, vector retrieval, reranking, and citation generation.
objectives: Construct complete RAG pipeline with context window injection.
Implement Cohere / FlashRank cross-encoder reranking.
Enforce strict groundedness with inline citation markers.

tasks.title: Production RAG Pipeline with Source Citations
tasks.description: Build an end-to-end RAG engine answering user questions about Uzair AI Studio projects, services, and tech stacks, with strict inline source citations.
steps: 1. Implement multi-query retrieval (rewrite ambiguous user questions).
2. Retrieve top 5 chunks and inject into grounded system prompt.
3. Generate response with explicit citation references [Doc 1, Page 3].
acceptanceCriteria: Zero hallucinations: if answer is not in context, responds with clear unknown notice.
Every factual assertion backed by retrieved chunk reference.
tasks.codeTemplate:
SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are Uzair AI Studio AI Concierge. Answer strictly based on the provided Context. If not mentioned in Context, state that you do not have sufficient information.
Context: {context}"""
tasks.hint: Evaluate with adversarial questions outside the context.

tasks.title: Cross-Encoder Reranker & Context Optimization
tasks.description: Incorporate a cross-encoder reranker (FlashRank / Cohere Rerank) to reorder retrieved candidates before feeding to LLM, reducing prompt token bloat by 40%.
steps: 1. Retrieve initial candidate pool of top 15 chunks via dense search.
2. Apply cross-encoder to score query-document relevance pairs.
3. Filter top 3 highest-scoring chunks for prompt context.
acceptanceCriteria: Precision@3 metric improves over raw vector retrieval.
Reduces input prompt token usage significantly.
tasks.codeTemplate:
from flashrank import Ranker, RerankRequest
ranker = Ranker()
results = ranker.rerank(RerankRequest(query=query, passages=passages))
tasks.hint: Log latency before and after reranker addition.

weeks.title: Autonomous LLM Agents, Tools & Function Calling
weeks.summary: Build autonomous agents capable of dynamic reasoning, tool selection, calculator/search invocation, and loop termination.
objectives: Master OpenAI/Gemini Tool & Function Calling protocols.
Implement ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop with scratchpad history.
Equip agents with custom tools: web search, database lookup, email dispatcher.

tasks.title: Custom Tool Suite & Function Calling Engine
tasks.description: Create a suite of executable tools (calculate_project_estimate, check_candidate_id, query_studio_availability) and wire them to an autonomous agent loop.
steps: 1. Define tool functions with comprehensive docstrings and typed arguments.
2. Inspect tool_calls in LLM response, execute matching Python function, and return tool message.
3. Allow LLM to summarize tool output for end-user.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent selects the correct tool based on user intent.
Gracefully handles tool execution failures and retries.
tasks.hint: Prevent infinite tool execution loops with a max_iterations guard (<= 5).

tasks.title: ReAct Autonomous Engineering Agent
tasks.description: Implement a full ReAct agent that autonomously plans, searches files, runs syntax checks, and reports bugs for a software repository.
steps: 1. Implement state graph with Thought -> Action -> Observation cycle.
2. Provide agent with file reading and command execution tools.
3. Test agent on finding a deliberate bug in a codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent successfully discovers and explains the target bug without human intervention.
Produces a clear audit trail of all intermediate thoughts and actions.
tasks.codeTemplate:
class AgentState(TypedDict):
    messages: list[BaseMessage]
    iterations: int
    is_resolved: bool
tasks.hint: Log intermediate steps to terminal with colored ANSI output.

weeks.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration & Workflow State Machines
weeks.summary: Orchestrate collaborative teams of specialized AI agents (Architect, Developer, Tester, Reviewer) using LangGraph.
objectives: Build stateful cyclical agent graphs with LangGraph.
Implement human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.
Coordinate multi-agent role handoffs and conflict resolution.

tasks.title: LangGraph Multi-Agent Software Development Team
tasks.description: Build a multi-agent system where a 'Product Manager' drafts user stories, a 'Developer Agent' writes Python code, and a 'QA Agent' runs tests and requests revisions.
steps: 1. Define GraphState containing project requirements, code draft, and test results.
2. Create nodes: `pm_node`, `developer_node`, `qa_node`.
3. Add conditional edge from `qa_node`: if tests pass -> END; else -> `developer_node`.
acceptanceCriteria: Code is iteratively refined until QA unit tests pass.
Terminates safely if max cycles (3) exceeded.
tasks.codeTemplate:
workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)
workflow.add_node("developer", dev_node)
workflow.add_node("qa", qa_node)
workflow.add_conditional_edges("qa", should_continue, {"retry": "developer", "end": END})
tasks.hint: Render workflow diagram using `graph.get_graph().print_ascii()`.

tasks.title: Human-in-the-Loop Approval & Memory Checkpoint
tasks.description: Incorporate interrupt checkpoints before critical actions (e.g. creating files, sending WhatsApp message) requiring explicit admin confirmation.
steps: 1. Configure LangGraph checkpointer using `MemorySaver()`.
2. Set `interrupt_before=['execute_action']` on critical nodes.
3. Build interactive CLI resuming state upon operator typing 'approve'.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent pauses execution state and persists to storage until human approval is delivered.
Rejection safely rolls back state.
tasks.codeTemplate: app = workflow.compile(checkpointer=MemorySaver(), interrupt_before=["commit_code"])
tasks.hint: Verify state resume works after restarting the Python process.

weeks.title: Model Evaluation, Ragas, LLM-as-a-Judge & Guardrails
weeks.summary: Implement quantitative evaluation frameworks: Ragas (faithfulness, answer relevance), NeMo Guardrails, and safety filters.
objectives: Evaluate RAG accuracy quantitatively using Ragas / TruLens.
Implement Llama-Guard / NeMo guardrails against prompt injection and toxic output.
Benchmark cost, latency, and tokens per task across models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3).

tasks.title: Automated Ragas Evaluation Benchmark
tasks.description: Create an automated test suite evaluating your studio RAG system over 25 synthetic questions measuring Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Precision.
steps: 1. Build synthetic evaluation dataset with Questions, Ground Truth, and Contexts.
2. Run Ragas evaluation metrics using an independent judge model.
3. Export metrics dataframe and generate bar charts comparing RAG configurations.
acceptanceCriteria: Achieves >= 0.85 Faithfulness and >= 0.80 Answer Relevance score.
